Class Game

java.lang.Object
main.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class Game extends Object implements Runnable
The Game class is the heart of the application. It manages the game loop, initializes main components, and handles state transitions. It implements Runnable to run the game loop in a separate thread.
